say:2:1631935001:1.text: Cassadee's been going out at night a lot recently and coming back very late.
say:2:1631935001:1.source_cn: 她最近总是晚上出去，很晚才回来。
say:2:1631935001:1.male: Cassadee's been going out at night a lot recently and coming back very late.
say:2:1631935001:1.female: Cassadee's been going out at night a lot recently and coming back very late.

say:3:1631935002:1.text: Even when she's home, she seems distracted, mumbling odd things like "mystery" and "sense" to herself.
say:3:1631935002:1.source_cn: 有时候到家后嘴里还念念有词，什么奥秘、洞悉之类奇怪的词语。
say:3:1631935002:1.male: Even when she's home, she seems distracted, mumbling odd things like "mystery" and "sense" to herself.
say:3:1631935002:1.female: Even when she's home, she seems distracted, mumbling odd things like "mystery" and "sense" to herself.

say:4:1631935003:1.text: When we asked her where she's been going, she said the library.
say:4:1631935003:1.source_cn: 我们也问过她晚上是去哪里，她说是去图书馆。
say:4:1631935003:1.male: When we asked her where she's been going, she said the library.
say:4:1631935003:1.female: When we asked her where she's been going, she said the library.

say:5:1631935004:1.text: But the library's closed at night...
say:5:1631935004:1.source_cn: 但我们也知道图书馆晚上并不开放，这……
say:5:1631935004:1.male: But the library's closed at night...
say:5:1631935004:1.female: But the library's closed at night...

say:6:1631935005:1.text: Cassadee's always been well-behaved, so all we can do is trust her.
say:6:1631935005:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂一直是个让人放心的孩子，我们只能相信她。
say:6:1631935005:1.male: Cassadee's always been well-behaved, so all we can do is trust her.
say:6:1631935005:1.female: Cassadee's always been well-behaved, so all we can do is trust her.
